_meta.description: This file contains the list of projects completed for real clients in a freelance capacity. Each entry includes the project name, description, live deployment URL, visual KPIs, phase timeline milestones, redacted proposals, and project case study footer settings.

fields.name: Display name of the client project.
fields.project_code: Project identification code used for webpage endpoints/data store folder name, etc
fields.project_logo: URL or path to the logo image of the project hosted in the data repository. Can be empty if not yet available.
fields.status: Current status of the project (e.g. Completed, In Progress).
fields.deployment: Live URL of the delivered project.
fields.image: URL or path to a screenshot or preview image of the project. Can be empty if not yet available.
fields.gallery: Array of objects of screenshots with their URL and custom descriptive caption.
fields.tech_stack: List of core technologies used to engineer the project.
fields.primary_kpi_summary: One-line pitch detailing the key business outcome.
fields.kpi_wins: List of outcomes containing visual charts structures (radial_gauge, bar_trend, comparison_blocks).
fields.phases: Timeline of contract phases with title, timeline, status, details and redacted proposals (files, title and subtitle).
fields.cta_footer: Dynamic bottom card parameters (title, subtitle/description, button text and its corresponding link).

projects.name: Tanukrit
projects.desc: Development, deployment and maintenance of Tanukrit's business landing website. Built for a non-technical client with complete understanding of their vision and design requirements and on-time delivery.

gallery.caption: Elegant landing page design showcasing curated handcrafted gifts and clean HSL spacing.
Fully optimized static content structure engineered for instant page transitions with modern UI & UX.
Fully responsive sections and UI elements featuring smooth interactive transitions.

projects.primary_kpi_summary: Achieved a 99/100 Lighthouse rating and a 180% increase in visitor engagement.

kpi_wins.description: Engineered core stylesheet improvements and dynamic image loaders, reducing load delays to zero.
Rebuilt page typography hierarchy and semantic meta layouts to secure high-visibility local SEO ranking.
Decoupled static copywriting data into client-manageable JSON manifests, making updates instantaneous.

phases.title: Core Website Engineering & Development
details: Executed a comprehensive pre-engagement audit mapping key usability and performance bottlenecks.
Refined the visual brand structure using smooth CSS flexboxes and a premium forest-green palette.
Designed clean skeleton page states to mask dynamic Github API hydration delays.

details: Performing continuous performance audits, security patch upgrades, and code health validations.
